method: Built-in image_gen; model selection managed by tool
style: Flat 2D children's storybook illustration in a sticker style. Bold, even outlines in dark plum #2b2250. Flat colour fills only: no gradients, no texture, no soft shading (one flat darker tone per shape at most). Rounded, friendly shapes. Use only these colours: #221a48, #322a6b, #463d8a, #3bb3a6, #d4f3ee, #f2c48a, #e8a24a, #fff8ec, #ffc94a, #ff7a45, #b9a6ff. Transparent background PNG. No text, no people, no logos.

subjects.hills-far: A long range of gentle rolling hills across the full width, with a small hilltop village of simple flat-roofed stone houses like old Bethlehem, a few windows glowing gold #ffc94a. Hills in #463d8a and #322a6b. Content only in bottom 45%; top fully transparent. Left and right edges line up so it can repeat. Canvas 1536x1024. No opaque sky.
subjects.hills-mid: Closer rolling hills in teal #3bb3a6 with a few round olive trees and a low stone sheepfold. Content only in bottom 40%, top transparent, left and right edges line up. Canvas 1536x1024. No opaque sky or characters.
subjects.ground-near: A foreground grassy bank with a winding sandy path #f2c48a entering from left edge and curving to centre, small coral and lilac flowers, a few pebbles. Content only in bottom 30%, top transparent. Canvas 1536x1024. No sky, no characters.
subjects.moon: One friendly crescent moon in cream #fff8ec with a lilac #b9a6ff shading shape. No face. Centred with lots of empty space around it. Canvas 1024x1024. This is a single isolated scenery asset for Little Light, no stars or extra decoration.
subjects.clouds: Three separate small puffy night clouds in #463d8a with lilac #b9a6ff rims, spread out horizontally with clear space between them. 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Absolutely no gradients/shading/glow/texture. Flat fills and dark plum outline.

notes: Originals preserved unchanged. Web derivatives trimmed and snapped to exact palette plus outline ink.
Landscape edges are approximate; integration uses single non-repeating layers.
